answer_1.quote: We propose an approach to generate counter-claims automatically ... we generate a large number (10‑30) of candidate counter‑claims ... and select the ones that have the highest contradiction score with the original claim.
answer_1.outputs: automatically generated counter‑claims (false statements) supporting dataset creation

answer_2.quote: We compute the contradiction score ... we convert the contradiction scores to binary outcomes ... we compute precision, recall, F1 score and accuracy for different thresholds.

answer_3.quote: To compute the contradiction score we use the RoBERTa model trained on Multi‑NLI ... we select the ones that have the highest contradiction score with the original claim.

answer_4.quote: We presented 150 randomly selected claims to Amazon Mechanical Turk workers ... annotators were presented with the original claim and five generated candidate counter‑claims ... they were then asked if those claims are implied by the original claim.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged whether each generated counter‑claim is contradictory (i.e., not implied) to the original claim.
